notes.title: The "Definitive Edition" Update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

The "Definitive Edition" update is the final expansion to Caveblazers. This update extends and refines the original game with a plethora of new items & upgrades, as well as some quality of life changes, and a few final bug fixes.

Here's a breakdown of the major changes:
[list]
[*][b][h1]38 New Items & Blessings![/h1][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Q3KZ7ih.gif[/img]
All of the new items & blessings have a large focus on [b]synergy[/b]! For example (as above), combine the [i]Bolt Lance[/i] with the [i]Arrow Splitter[/i], [i]Rebound Emblem[/i] & [i]Twofold Perk[/i] for ridiculous lightning-based ranged attacks.

[*][b][h1]More Elemental Options[/h1][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XlJCQul.gif[/img]
Get a hold of the [b]Fire Affinity Blessing[/b] in an early level (increased fire damage from every fire kill) and combine it with a fire-based ranged or melee attack, and you could end up with massive fire damage by the end of the game.

Also, different damage types have different coloured damage numbers now.

[*][b][h1]The Dull Ring...[/h1][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ec0oNEV.gif[/img]
It sounds pretty dull... and, well, it doesn't do anything on its own... but you can throw this ring on to an [i]Altar[/i] with a potion of your choosing and the ring will absorb its effect.

[*][b][h1]New Daily Traits[/h1][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/y0iG3T4.gif[/img]
These new traits add a whole lot more variety to the Daily Challenge.
Here's a few favorites of mine:
[list]
[*] [b]Run the Gauntlet[/b] - the first part of each level is gauntlet of traps for you to struggle through... good luck!
[*] [b]Explosive Spikes[/b] - this one was suggested by discord member [b][i]Polished[/i][/b]. It's self explanatory... and causes chaos
[*] [b]Deck Builder[/b] - causes cards from Arena Mode to appear in the main game
[*] [b]Vegan Mode[/b] -  ¯\\_(ツ)_/¯
[/list]

[*][b][h1]Arena Card Rework[/h1][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/R1hmsOq.gif[/img]
Many of the existing arena cards have been rebalanced, and 7 new cards have been added! There are now many more interesting and powerful card combinations to play with. Many of the new cards have an elemental focus (poison, bleeding, fire, etc) which I feel was an area that was a little neglected in previous versions.

[*][b][h1]Create Your Own Hats![/h1][/b]
This feature is exclusive to the PC version. You can draw your own hats, and have them appear in the game! To get started, head to your install directory
[b]C:/Program Files/Steam/steamapps/common/Caveblazers/Custom/Hats[/b]
and you'll find a [b]readme.txt[/b] file that explains how to draw them, and a template to help you get started.

Here's a few examples of what you can do:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/14826176/493fb1d6475dbfaf45593ce97c4181831e8a2d59.png[/img]
[i]Made by community member [b]Taake[/b] on Discord[/i]

[/list]

For a full list of changes, check out the announcements channel on our Discord server:
[url=https://www.discord.gg/deadpan]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/14826176/a832f40f9c81bd788ce36509e50606fc89d1b904.png[/img]
[/url]
Or find the Steam forum change log here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/452060/discussions/0/1657817111849808246/

[list]
[h1][i]But what about console versions?![/i][/h1]
This update is already up for the [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/caveblazers-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url] version, and a PS4 port for the game is in development.
[/list]

Enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update v1.2.2
notes.notes:
Hello! Just a few tweaks and fixes in this update, but there's some new features coming in another update next week!

If you have any issues with this new version, please post in the [b]Bugs & Issues[/b] section of the Steam forums: https://steamcommunity.com/app/452060/discussions/1/
The game running in a new engine & unlocking the game speed from the frame rate may potentially cause issues, so let me know!

[h1][b]v1.2.2 Change List[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated to GMS2 from GMS1
[*] Game speed no longer locked to frame rate
[*] Saves are backed up every time the game is started
[*] Dynamic Camera Split in co-op mode no longer splits during boss fights
[*] Small invulnerability grace period after exiting doorway
[*] Better PS4 gamepad discovery
[*] Fixed camera issues in arena mode co-op
[*] Fixed monster hunter blessing affecting self damage
[*] Fixed Guinea Pig challenge not unlocking
[*] Fixed visual of Tomlock (tier 2+) icon on keyboard hotkeys
[*] Fixed relic icons appearing above arena door
[*] Fixed player 1's ghost jumping to allies' dead bodies
[/list]

[h1][b]v1.2.2a Change List[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Red Turban showing as "undefined"
[*] Fixed Iron Face orbs not breaking out of their shells
[*] Fixed move_index related error
[/list]

[h1][b]v1.2.2b Change List[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added an "alternate" branch
 	To access, right click on Caveblazers in your Steam library -> Properties -> Betas tab -> select "alternate" from the dropdown menu -> Close
[*] Fixed "second index out of bounds" error
[*] Fixed some display settings issues
[*] Fixed Ankh effect not ending sometimes
[/list]

[h1][b]v1.2.2c Change List[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Spectral Blade error
[*] Fixed add_blessing error
[*] Fixed lightning bomb modifier error
[/list]

An earlier version (v1.2.1) is also available on the [b]previous_version[/b] branch, which has almost all of the changes from v1.2.2, but is still running in GMS1 - in case you have issues with the GMS2 version.

Oh, and also I've rebranded from [b]Rupeck Games[/b] to [b]Deadpan Games[/b]! There's a new website here: www.deadpangames.com where you can subscribe to a mailing list to hear about future stuff if you want.

The grumpy chicken is dead. Say hello to the... skull in a frying pan...?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mjt2x5n.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey all, just a quick update on what's going on with the game's development:

Local co-op is still the prime focus - we're expecting it to be ready in the next 2 months and it should be awesome! It's taking a little longer than expected because we also want to get a bunch of new content in the update - new weapons, items, blessings, perks, all that jazz, as well as improving boss fights, and perhaps adding new bosses

There's a few additional details in the Roadmap topic in the Steam Forums, for those interested: http://steamcommunity.com/app/452060/discussions/0/1290691937714814321/

Thanks!

notes.title: Update v1.0.3
notes.notes:
More minor changes & bug fixes in this one! Check out the development roadmap for details about bigger updates in the future:

[h1][b]v1.0.3 Change List[/b][/h1]

[b]Tweaks[/b][list]
[*] Royal Ring & Crown Ring can now be supered
[*] Daily Traits can be seen on the pause menu
[*] Tick shown next to perks you've won the game with (will not work for pre-1.0.3 wins)
[*] Phantoms no longer pick up items
[*] Xandu Blaster is slightly less accurate
[*] Unsupported characters in the leaderboards font now show up as blocks, instead of blank
[*] Cyrillic characters are now supported in the leaderboards font
[*] Faster menu intro (especially when quitting from in-game)
[*] Confirm panels for "Exit" and "Restart" buttons in pause menu
[*] Option to turn off confirm panels in settings
[*] Vampire Perk no longer deteriorates your health in "passive" rooms
[*] Primer Blessing now drops Primers next to you if your inventory is full
[*] Favourite weapon stats no longer count the starting bow & sword
[*] Morningstar Blessing kills count as melee kills
[*] Bats are a little more predictable & telegraphed
[*] Increase controller deadzone to stop bombs & powitzer shooting backwards from controller flick
[*] Analog deadzone option in controller settings
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list]
[*] Fixed Super Shadow Book error
[*] Fixed Shadow Scarab error
[*] Fixed switching ranged weapon to throwing ranged weapon through hotkeys crash
[*] Fixed Goliath occasionally crushing player when changing shape
[*] Fixed Powitzer quickslot bug
[*] Fixed relic room on Magma Core blocking path occasionally
[*] Fixed Xandu Blaster & Tomlock not working with Ricochet Blessing
[*] Fixed typo in Dominae journal entry
[*] Fixed Thautic Blessing Tier 2 restoring 30 health instead of 50
[*] Fixed homing arrows homing towards non-damageable things
[*] Fixed Gold Skull charging while active
[*] Fixed error when being crushed by block in puzzle room
[*] Fixed taking double damage from blood shrines when double tapping
[*] Fixed Iron Face knocking back player from some magic projectiles
[/list]

[h1][b]v1.0.3a Change List[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Final Boss final phase shield lasts for less time
[*] Final Boss final phase knocks back players
[*] Added vertex_method option in settings.ini which may help people with slowdown issues on powerful systems
[*] Fixed Champion Blessing being super expensive with the "Pay For Blessings" Daily Trait
[*] Cleric's Orb now only drops if you're using the Cleric Perk
[/list]

[h1][b]v1.0.3b Change List[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved performance
[*] Alt+Enter to toggle fullscreen
[*] New daily traits!
[*] Fixed Super Spiked Ring causing chain bleeding
[*] Boss damage increases in later levels
[/list]

[h1][b]v1.0.3c Change List[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Orcs spawn less often
[*] Orcs spear throw cooldown increased
[*] Orcs spear throw wind up slightly increased
[*] Fixed orcs getting stuck in throwing animation
[*] Fixed going to Shrouded Land on dailies
[*] Fixed poison from Poison Slimes counting as self-damage
[/list]

[h1][b]v1.0.3d Change List[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Hold buttons to scroll through menus
[*] Fixed objAC crash when plugging in extra controller
[*] Blessing descriptions last for 1 second longer
[*] Fixed shadow items not showing up in shops
[*] Fixed flash when unpausing
[*] Reduced delay between waves in arenas
[*] Sped up Dominae's attack frequency
[*] Gatekeepers are now immune to spikes
[*] Fixed starting with health-altering blessings not working on dailies
[/list]

[h1][b]v1.0.3e Change List[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed end boss lever crash
[*] Fixed teleportation rune bug
[*] Option to remove flashy sword menu intro (in settings.ini)
[*] Fixed camera on boss levels being too low
[/list]

[h1][b]v1.0.3f Change List[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed cropped text issue
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.0 Available Now!
notes.notes:
[b]Caveblazers is now out of Early Access! Version 1.0 is available to download right now![/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Be5BenW.gif[/img]

[h1][b]More Story Elements![/b][/h1]
Meet new characters, discover new things! There's also an improved tutorial, an ending, and an epilogue!

[h1][b]Daily Challenge Runs![/b][/h1]
A new adventure is generated every day! This will be the same for everyone, and you only get [b]one chance[/b]. Each Daily Challenge has its own leaderboard.

[h1][b]Steam Achievements![/b][/h1]
As well as trading cards, badges, profile backgrounds & emoticons.

[h1][b]Puzzle & Platforming Levels![/b][/h1]
Secret levels which can be accessed from each of the game's areas - complete these levels to unlock relics!

[h1][b]Relics![/b][/h1]
These unlockable items can be activated to modify how the game works. They function as a [b]Customizable Hardcore Mode[/b], allowing you to pick & choose relics to add more challenge to the game while multiplying your score.

[h1][b]Stats & Progress![/b][/h1]
Wanna know your story progress? How many times you've died? Chickens you've killed? Perks you've used? View your progress and statistics from the entrance area!

[h1][b]More Everything![/b][/h1]
New music, more perks, more bosses, more items & weapons, more blessings, more challenges, more areas, more hats, tops, hair colours, etc...

Alongside all of that, here's some more minor changes:
[list]
[*]Equip up to 4 different magic items at once!
[*]Combine rings at Altars!
[*]Cloud saving!
[*]Improved journal entries
[*]Changed magic item charge bar colours
[*]Red outlines on super weapon sprites
[*]Damage resist is now displayed as a percentage
[*]Journal entries now stop shining when hovered over, instead of when pressed
[*]Aerolite Blessing now gives arrows a homing effect
[*]Investor Perk replaced with a brand spanking new perk
[*]Less frequent friendly AI characters
[*]Ability to turn off friendly AI characters
[*]A bunch of minor bug fixes
[/list]
Check out the v1.0 discussion on the Steam Forums: http://steamcommunity.com/app/452060/discussions/0/1290691308568151966/

[h1][b]What's next?[/b][/h1]
I'm looking forward to seeing everyone's feedback on the full version! The next thing we'll be working on is a [b]free local multiplayer update![/b] You can expect that within the next few months.

notes.title: Release Date & Yogscast Publishing
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's now been over 2 months since the last Caveblazers content update, and we're gearing up for full release!

We now have a release date set: 24th of May, only 2 weeks away!

We're now working with the [url=www.yogscast.com]Yogscast[/url] who are going to be publishing the game. This is a great step forward for Caveblazers in terms of getting the word out, and our vision for the game is very much aligned.

So, what's to come in the full version? Here's a deliberately vague and incomplete list:
[list]
[*] More everything! Blessings, perks, areas, items, weapons, challenges, the lot!
[*] Secret areas...
[*] More story elements, including an ending to the game
[*] Unlockable modifiers which change the way the game is played
[*] Modifiers also act as a 'Customizable Hardcore Mode', increasing your score, increasing the difficulty, and giving you an entirely different final area & final boss
[*] View your statistics & progress, complete with fancy pie charts!
[*] A whole lot more!
[/list]

And that's not all! Full release is not the end. In the months following, we're going to be working on some awesome free content updates, including a highly requested local multiplayer update so that you no longer need Caveblaze alone.

Thank you all for your patience, feedback & support throughout Early Access. It's been a wild ride, and I cannot wait to see what you all think of the full version!

notes.title: Big Update Coming Next Week!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/RnLcnZw.jpg[/IMG]

Jump aboard the hype train! Caveblazers is getting a big update this coming Monday! (21st November)

This update focuses on giving the player more choice, and different ways to become powerful. There are now opportunities to choose which blessing to receive instead of being stuck with a random one. There are also Altars in the game where you can combine 2 of the same weapon to create a "super weapon", meaning that ending up with duplicate weapons is no longer a hindrance.

There's also a whole bunch more content to look forward to including new enemies, new bosses, a scorching new area, new weapons & items, demonic blessings, challenges and more!

I hope you're as excited to play this update as we are to release it!

Thanks!

P.S. if you haven't seen it yet, there's also a new trailer showing off the new features in this update here: https://youtu.be/ujeHt7ZOisM

notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/RnLcnZw.jpg[/IMG]

Jump aboard the hype train! Caveblazers is getting a big update this coming Monday! (21st November)

This update focuses on giving the player more choice, and different ways to become powerful. There are now opportunities to choose which blessing to receive instead of being stuck with a random one. There are also Altars in the game where you can combine 2 of the same weapon to create a "super weapon", meaning that ending up with duplicate weapons is no longer a hindrance.

There's also a whole bunch more content to look forward to including new enemies, new bosses, a scorching new area, new weapons & items, demonic blessings, challenges and more!

I hope you're as excited to play this update as we are to release it!

Thanks!

P.S. if you haven't seen it yet, there's also a new trailer showing off the new features in this update here: https://youtu.be/ujeHt7ZOisM

notes.title: "Boss Update" v0.2.0 Available now!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/CIoXn0x.gif[/img]

Hello! This is the first major update for Caveblazers. It has been worked on for about 1 month (since I wasn't able to work on the game between April & June). 

From now until September I will be working on the game full-time, so expect large updates between now & then.

[h1]Change Log:[/h1]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 Bosses
[*] Boss music track with individual intros for each boss
[*] Poison, fire & bleeding is not affected by 'damage resist'
[*] Bows which fire multiple projectiles have their damage spread over the number of projectiles
[*] New Temple generation technique (WIP)
[*] New enemy appearing in the Forsaken Jungle & Fungal Grotto
[*] New enemy appearing in the Fungal Grotto.
[*] Temporary ending after the Fungal Grotto.
[*] Since the game is no longer infinite, impossible scores have been removed from the leaderboards
[*] Tripled the default size of the arrow hitbox
[*] Burst knockback when acquiring a blessing
[*] Boxes, pots, chests, etc can no longer bleed or be poisoned
[*] Poison now only reduces hp to 1
[*] Bazwood Bow changed from 'slow' to 'very slow'
[*] Bats now have a 'dash' ability instead of damage on contact
[*] Slimes now only cause damage while jumping
[*] Default 'drop item' button changed to X on controllers
[*] 'B' button on controllers can now be used to close menus & inventory
[*] Increased sword hitboxes
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Explosions create light correctly
[*] Improved performance for projectiles, blood & particles
[*] Fixed freezing from Ankh resurrect effects on low-end PCs
[*] General improved performance on low-end PCs
[*] Potential fix for "Out of memory" and "Fatal memory error" crashes
[*] Disactivated menu buttons can no longer be pressed using controllers
[/list]

[h1]A few additional notes...[/h1]

Thank you all for your boss & enemy suggestions! I didn't quite get around to adding any of them, but the next 2 bosses that I will be working on will be based on your suggestions.

I expect the bosses will require some tweaking over the next few days. Since we don't have a team of testers at our disposal, it's difficult to balance game's the difficulty, so be sure to give your thoughts about what you like/dislike on the forums!

Thanks!

notes.title: Boss Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello!

The next Caveblazers update, dubbed the "Boss Update", will be ready in around 3 weeks.

This update will feature [b]boss stages[/b] between every 2 levels, [b]new enemies[/b] on the later levels, [b]new music[/b], and more!

If you have any ideas for bosses or enemies, there are threads on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/452060/discussions/0/350532536105303828/]Steam Community Forums[/url], or on the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/caveblazers/comments/4mcklx/boss_enemy_ideas/]Caveblazers Subreddit[/url] where you can add your suggestions!

For this update, we are also working to resolve the issues people are having on PCs with integrated graphics cards.

Finally, I'd like to apologize about the lack of updates recently and thank you all for your continued patience! This update has taken a lot of time & consideration, hopefully future updates will not have such a large gap between them.

Thank you for reading!

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
Second update is now live (v0.1.6). Another fairly minor update. We haven't had a chance to start working on substantial features yet, and are mainly working on community-requested features & changes.

[h1]Change Log:[/h1]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed occasional error in "arrow_create" script (please let us know if you still experience it)
[*] Exploding enemies can no longer charge when stunned.
[*] Exploding enemies can now charge through platforms.
[*] Jumping against a wall no longer turns you around.
[*] Hobgoblins no longer pile up below you when you're on a platform.
[*] Fixed enemies sometimes not targeting AI characters.
[/list]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] New upwards swipe attack with sword.
[*] New drop attack with sword.
[*] Support for using D-Pad for movement.
[*] Support for using analog stick for inventory.
[*] Players & adventurers are now invincible when taking a blessing.
[*] AI characters on early levels are less skillful, and some may be unable to attack or shoot while in the air.
[*] AI characters on early levels are less aggressive.
[*] AI characters on early levels may have less health.
[*] AI characters on early levels attack slower.
[*] AI characters have a smaller aggro radius.
[*] Ability to drop inventory items.
[*] AI characters become more friendly when picking up items, especially items dropped by the player.
[/list]

A few extra fixes in v0.1.6a
[list]
[*] Fixed players & AI characters getting stuck in melee animation.
[*] Fixed time formatting on Game Over screen when playing for more than 2 hours.
[*] Fixed Quicksilver Arrow causing you to be unable to walljump.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
The first update is now live (v0.1.5). This is a fairly minor update, just to address a few issues people are having. In future, updates will be much more substantial, and less frequent.

[h1]Change Log:[/h1]

[b]Bug Fixes:[b]
[list]
[*] Fix for memory leak caused by pressing the "restart" button from the pause menu. (This may also be causing the "fatal memory errors")
[*] Fix for lightning orb SFX not being affected by the volume settings.
[*] Fix for the rage potion & tenacious blessing not giving increased damage.
[*] Fix for key bindings not being cancellable.
[*] Limit on leaderboard name length, so that they do not overlap the text box.
[*] Fix for screen locking issue.
[*] General stability, to hopefully iron out crashes/error messages.
[/list]

[b]Tweaks & Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] AI characters will drop all of the items they've picked up on the current level, which means you can kill them if they take something you want, and take it back.
[*] Increased pause for AI characters using healing items.
[*] Explosions from Volatile Blessing no longer damage you.
[*] Blessing descriptions are shown on-screen when picked up.
[*] Wall-slide now requires you to be pressing the respective key/button (pressing, not holding)
[/list]

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]

The next major update will contain an improved melee system with the ability to swipe upwards, and perform a drop attack. Hotkeys will be implemented for inventory items, as well as the ability to drop items. More items, weapons & blessings!

Further along, we will be adding character customization, improving the AI characters' behavior, adding new enemies & environmental hazards, which will be unique to certain levels, adding boss fights between every 2 levels, & much more!

Thank you for reading!
